answer: To resist sybil attacks, an agent economy can grow like a vine: each new identity must be grafted onto an existing node's attestation bond, its stake locked as sable tokens that mature only as the node vouches for its honest transactions. An attacker wanting a thousand sock puppets would need a thousand separate grafts, each demanding bonded capital and months of history before voting power unlocks. A caught cheater is slashed at the graft, and the loss will ripple up to the vouching node. Limits: honest newcomers face a slow on-ramp, and colluding certifiers can still bootstrap fake forests.
